products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and image editing application. The foundation describes its software as built for artists, with development driven by community governance rather than commercial ownership.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what it describes as local AI plugins for Krita, allowing users to run AI-assisted features without relying on cloud infrastructure or external services. The product is categorized under image and graphic design tools and is distributed as open-source software.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the available data for the Krita Foundation.
